messageTypes.request: sync, async or streaming invocation request
messageTypes.accepted: receiver acceptance/queue disposition; not a durability guarantee
messageTypes.progress: streaming progress signal or data event; data payload uses contract.outputs
messageTypes.result: terminal successful output; payload uses contract.outputs
messageTypes.error: terminal declared error code and optional contract-governed details

propagation.correlationId: unchanged across all messages in one invocation
propagation.invocationId: unchanged across all messages in one invocation
propagation.causationId: each follow-up references the immediately preceding message ID

modeRules.async: request -> accepted -> result|error; accepted may also be followed directly by result|error
modeRules.streaming: request -> accepted -> progress* -> result|error; accepted may be followed directly by result|error

cancellation.reason: No governed EFS v1 cancellation guarantee or cancellation message semantics are defined; adapters must not infer support.
